steps.content: The Apostle falls backwards. Beaten up and humiliated by a little girl, it roars in fury and struggles to make a comeback.

The little lion that beat up the Apostle is floating in the void. She's not used to her power yet. Her body aches all over, and her skull tremors each time the giant beast roars, as if something inside her is resonating with it.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Phew... I'm... so awesome...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So being a hero is this powerful. I practically set off a little supernova! No wonder happy endings are so common...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...It's a bit sudden... but since it actually happened to me, the audience should be able to believe it...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...If I knew I had this in me, I would've used it a lot sooner...

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak... Squeak squeak...

Eyes brimming with tears, Stella looks back and forth between OwO and the main body that is quickly recovering itself. The little critter clings onto OwO's clothes and nibbles on her wrist, trying to keep her awake.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe... Don't worry, Stella. I won't hurt it. I know it's your family. I just want it to come back to its senses... I want it to know that you're back...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella, you must really miss home. You always look into the distance whenever you glow... I know you've been calling out to them all this time...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I don't want you to experience the heartbreak that I've felt...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All right, next up... an awesome lion dance...
A huge boulder floats over and OwO climbs onto it. She takes a deep breath and springs toward the Apostle that's a thousand times her size. Her golden lion's head shimmering across the sea of stars.

S.T. recovers quickly. There are too many clones all over Dillywood and DisCity. Burgeoning desire gives it strength. The Apostle yearns to return to DisSea, and its perseverance will make it stronger.

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak!!!
The little clone wants to push OwO away, but it's powerless to stop this mighty, newborn Sinner. It yelps tearfully at the Apostle of Ashes, but the Apostle turns a deaf ear.

They were so close. In her mind's eye, OwO sees the hands of all those who have pushed her forward, yet ultimately left her: the crew of My Best Cool Car, the kind neighbors who raised her, and the compatriots from the homeland she never knew.

This long yet short-lived journey has finally reached its end. After sending Stella home, everything will go back to the way it was. She'd return to that lonely terrace to lion dance and gaze afar alone. OwO sniffles.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Everything's fine... I'm great already. It's fine if I don't get a DisCar, and it's fine if there's no big happy ending. They'd be proud of me nonetheless.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Just like ${PlayerName} said, I'm someone they'd be proud of...
The humongous Apostle roars, condensing energy into a violent gale that hurtles toward OwO. The vortex of Mania blurs the girl's vision.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella, let me send you home...

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
steps.content: Roar...!
Purple shadows strangle the Apostle's neck and body. Some similar but opposing energies cancel each other out, completely restraining its movement. The Apostle's chilling voice echoes from the void.
...Cut... It's not the climax yet... This won't do...
OwO senses something coming up from behind, catching her before she loses her last ounce of strength.
It's a warm, familiar scent that instantly brings tears to her eyes. OwO turns around...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Lion heads... Just like mine... You are...
The lion in lead nods and gives her faltering body a push, helping her complete the final step across the stars.
Stella is desperately leaning forward in OwO's arms. The girl holds the little critter out with her hands, sending it off for the final time.
The little blue critter's cries echo across the entire space. Bathed in light, it leaps from OwO's hands onto the manic Apostle's forehead and merges into it.
Dazzling light floods the realm. When OwO opens her eyes again, the manic behemoth had quieted down, and is emitting the same glow as Stella.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
steps.content: I... cannot... control... too dangerous... to stay... must go...

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
steps.content: The dummy... in my place... protect...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You're... Stella?

A massive fissure opens up behind the Apostle, revealing a huge unknown realm. OwO shudders. She instinctively reaches out for Stella, but the person in the black lion's head grabs her and holds her tightly.

She wanted to struggle, but the beast comes forward and presses against her forehead. The manic energy runs wild in its body, yet culminates with flowers blooming from its head, which fall and land on OwO.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
steps.content: ...Gave me back... family... thank you...

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
steps.content: I'm... going back...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wait... Ahhh!
"Stella" backs up into the fissure, returning to the chaos from which it was born. The realm overflows with flowers scattered across the sky like meteors, giving a grand finale to Stella's journey.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes?
steps.content: Squeak...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahh...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Goodbye, Stella... Goodbye...

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: The effects of the Apostle S.T. are confirmed to have stopped. Before that, a second center had appeared in the Mania field and engulfed the original center, merging into a new, highly unstable Mania field.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: It was a struggle for power following the return of the clones. We speculate that interactions with humans may have altered the consciousness of certain clones, which led to conflict with the main body.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Fortunately, we not only avoided heavy casualties this time, but also discovered some of the Apostle's secret characteristics. We are one step closer to uncovering the truth about the Apocalypse outside DisCity. However...

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Why did that last Apostle choose to leave? Originally, its main body didn't hesitate to barge into DisCity and suffer heavy injuries to get to DisSea...
Sob sob...
A string of sobs comes from the MBCC agent's side.

steps.speaker: MBCC Intelligence Agent
steps.content: Let's just say... The Apostle's family is no longer angry after finding their lost child. They reunited and went back to their homeland together.
